# Crypto Survivors

> Crypto Survivors is a real-time market-driven survival game where live Bitcoin (BTC/USD) price feeds dynamically shape difficulty, enemy behaviors, and roguelite progression.

## Links

- [Crypto Survivors Game](https://crypto-survivors.com/): Official game client and landing portal
- [Documentation Hub](https://crypto-survivors.com/docs): Comprehensive documentation and guides
- [Market Architecture](https://crypto-survivors.com/docs/architecture): Real-time market data streaming and difficulty scaling engine
- [Tokenomics & Mechanics](https://crypto-survivors.com/TOKENOMICS.md): In-game economy, scoring system, and multipliers
